approach:
Root cause: landing, history and attribution rules are derived from the happy-path commit shape (the job's own commits). The only guard is planner/critic prose (planner.md:16, critic.md:14), so jobs 20261024-153908-1rve, 20261024-154552-e65v and 20261025-012657-hac3 each had a reading accepted whose criteria never required a branch with an intervention commit, a records-only commit and the job landing. Fix: one pure check, `pub fn check_history_fixture(reading: &Reading) -> Result<()>`, in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, added as one `step!(check_history_fixture(reading));` line in `refusing_check` right after `check_code_survey` (reading.rs:3246). It sits where readings are accepted, not at one pr_commits or trailer instance.

Changes after the round-2 findings:
(a) The file-path trigger is dropped entirely (finding 2). A listed path no longer triggers anything, so land.rs, reconcile.rs and gh.rs jobs about queues, CI baselines or dispatch branches are not refused.
(b) The trigger is classification phrases and function names found in criterion text only. `landing` alone triggers nothing.
(c) The doc comment and CHANGELOG no longer blame the reader token budget for the missing rule line (finding 3). The real reasons are: this reading's decision not to grow reader-facing text, and briefs.rs, where READING_RULES lives (briefs.rs:2225), not being a listed deliverable. The reader still gets the refusal text, with an example criterion, on its immediate second read (the `refusal` field, briefs.rs:2211-2213).
(d) The doc comment states that retry-after-block and any other branch shape are not enforced, and that the planner's commit-shape table remains the guard (finding 4). The refusal message also suggests naming them.
(e) The share is re-estimated from commits that changed classification behavior (finding 2).
(f) The refusal_corpus.rs edit is justified (finding 1).

Gate: same as `check_code_survey` (capability set, no question, class `code` or `tests`, at least one Behavior criterion), factored into one private helper.

Trigger: any criterion of any kind whose lowercase, white-space-collapsed, straight-apostrophe text holds one of these phrases, matched with `has_phrase`: `commit shape`, `commit shapes`, `commit-shape`, `pr_commits`, `classify_commit`, `classify_pre_merge`, `history check`, `attribution check`, `records-only commit`, `records only commit`, `trailer`, `trailers`, `--history`, `--attribution`, `--pr-head`. `has_phrase` tests only `char::is_alphanumeric` at each end (reading.rs:3752), so `_` and `-` count as boundaries; the doc and tests say so. The `Code survey:` assumption is not searched: a survey of land.rs for a queue job may name `classify_commit` without the change touching it.

Satisfied when a Behavior criterion holds `realistic`, `fixture`, `intervention commit`, `records-only commit` (or `records only commit`) and `job landing` (or `job's landing`). Otherwise bail with "the reading was refused because ...", naming the matched phrase and giving an example criterion that also suggests naming every other shape the branch produces, such as a retry-after-block landing.

The check reads only the Reading: no model call, no repository, no records, no network. It does not touch land.rs, gh.rs, invariant.rs, commits.rs or athena-git, so no classification function changes and no commit-shape table applies.

decisions.choice: Enforce at the reading-stage gate: `step!(check_history_fixture(reading));` right after `check_code_survey` in `refusing_check`.
decisions.reason: All three failures began when a reading was accepted whose criteria never required a branch with more than job commits. `refusing_check` is the one seam every reading passes: `check_reading_acceptance` (reading.rs:3199), `check_reading_text` for `athena check-reading` and the replay, and `Athena::read`. The step name comes from `stringify!`. The new line sits outside the pinned adjacencies (governance to outcome_state to environment_reach).

decisions.choice: Trigger on classification phrases and function names in criterion text only. No file-path trigger and no bare `landing`. The `Code survey:` assumption is not searched.
decisions.reason: Finding 2: land.rs also exports `plan` (land.rs:77) and `resync_tip` (land.rs:163), and HISTORY.txt shows fe1df4f (CI baseline, reconcile.rs), 1bc7736 (dispatch branch, land.rs) and the async drain touching these files with no commit-shape rule. A path trigger would force an irrelevant fixture on them. The phrases are what actually mark a commit-classification rule: all three source jobs say `pr_commits`, `commit shape` or `trailer` in their criteria. A survey assumption may name a function the change only reads.

decisions.choice: The satisfying criterion must be a Behavior criterion naming `realistic`, `fixture`, an intervention commit, a records-only commit and the job landing. The doc comment's limits paragraph says plainly that retry-after-block and any other shape the branch produces are not enforced, that the planner's commit-shape table remains the guard, and the refusal message suggests naming them.
decisions.reason: Finding 4: the reading fixes three shapes, so a lexical check can enforce only those. Requiring a fourth would raise the refusal share beyond the declared estimate. demonstrations.method:
New unit tests in the reading.rs tests module, driven through production `check_reading_acceptance` and `refusing_check` with the existing helpers `code_reading`, `add_behavior`, `accept` and `refuser`.
(a) `history_fixture_refuses_a_rule_tested_only_on_job_commits`: a code reading with the SURVEY assumption and a Behavior criterion such as 'Run `cargo test -p athena-core land::`: pr_commits accepts the job commits' is refused with `refuser == Some("check_history_fixture")`. The error holds 'was refused', the matched phrase, 'realistic-branch fixture', 'intervention commit', 'records-only commit', 'job landing' and 'retry-after-block'. After adding the Behavior criterion 'Run `cargo test -p athena-core --test reconcile`: the realistic-branch fixture holds an intervention commit, a records-only commit and the job landing, and the rule classifies each', `refuser` is None and `accept` is Ok. Spelling variants (`records only commit`, `job's landing`, curly apostrophe, extra white space) are accepted. A Content-kind fixture criterion, a criterion missing one shape, and a criterion without 'fixture' stay refused.
(b) The three source-job shapes, each refused without and accepted with the fixture criterion: `history_fixture_job_1rve_shape` (deliverables land.rs, gh.rs, invariant.rs, docs/design/records-history.md, CHANGELOG.md; criterion on pr_commits content classification), `history_fixture_job_e65v_shape` (land.rs, invariant.rs; criterion that the reconcile merge method follows the commit shape), `history_fixture_job_hac3_shape` (commits.rs, manage.rs, an athena-git attrs.rs, status.rs, auditor.rs; criterion that no Athena trailers are written after C0). A criterion-only trailer test has deliverables manage.rs and status.rs.
(c) `history_fixture_refusal_needs_the_step_line` greps the `refusing_check` body for the step and fails if it is removed.
demonstrations.observes: A code reading for a landing, history or attribution rule, in the shape of each of the three source jobs, is refused with an actionable message when no Behavior criterion names a realistic-branch fixture with the three shapes, and is accepted once one does.
